task: Ground desktop CLI supervisor MVP claims
output_summary: The change implements a bounded Tauri CLI adapter health-check bridge and Workspace Monitor Desktop tab for optional Claude Code CLI, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, and OpenCode setup visibility.

evidence.reliability: Official Tauri guide for frontend-to-Rust command calls.
Official Tauri shell plugin documentation used as a boundary reference for future process execution.
Official xterm.js addon guide used as future terminal UI reference.
Official Monaco Editor repository used as future editor reference.
Updated local Rust source for Tauri backend commands.
Local command verification recorded in the validation and evaluation files.

claims.statement: The Tauri backend now exposes commands for listing CLI adapters and running bounded CLI adapter health checks.
The Workspace Monitor includes a Desktop tab that uses the Tauri invoke bridge when available and falls back safely in a regular browser.
verification_steps: Run `npm --prefix workspace-monitor run check` and `npm --prefix workspace-monitor run build`.

claims.statement: This change does not implement interactive PTY sessions, stdin writes, long-running CLI task execution, or public macOS installer readiness.
verification_steps: Inspect the backend command list and documentation non-scope sections.
Confirm no xterm.js, Monaco, or PTY dependencies were added.

claims.statement: The selected external technical references were official Tauri documentation, official xterm.js documentation, and the official Monaco Editor repository.

uncertainty_notes: Rust compilation was not verified because Rust is not installed on this machine.
Installed CLI runtime behavior still needs smoke tests on machines where the four CLIs are present.
limitation_notes: The MVP is limited to PATH detection and version health checks.
Browser-level visual verification used static build and type/test checks because no callable in-app browser tool was available in this turn.
